line: A satellite follows the map to the Aral Sea and finds a desert; only the part someone dammed came back.
line_cn: 卫星照着地图去找咸海，找到的是沙漠；只有筑了坝的那一块回来了。

camera.serves: an opening; a return; a title card
time running in one place; a measurement
one town, one dam, one field
measuring; a river, a road, a border

camera.expresses: a new subject at the same altitude

transitions: Transitions: scan-line swaps, a map layer switched off, zooming through plates, whip pans, the reticle opening into a title card.
No crossfades between unrelated places, no hard cuts inside a zoom.
labels: Roles: a light condensed grotesk for the reading (96–130 px, e.g. Barlow Condensed); a monospace for instruments and dates (20–34 px, e.g. IBM Plex Mono); a sans for labels in the film's language (24–42 px); a serif only for the claim layer and the title. OFL, self-hosted, CJK subset to the characters used.
Labels attach to the ground with a leader line. The reading sits in the right third beside what it measures, label above, source note below ("Landsat, measured").

Subtitles are a transcript strip at the bottom left: a 2 px white rule, a dark plate fading right, left-aligned, each line on one line (measure with the real font, nowrap; split a long sentence into two cues). If the film is bilingual, the film's language on top.
Nothing below 20 px at 1080p, the imagery credit included.
motion: The camera never stops: distance interpolates in log space, segments ease, holds keep a 2–5 % creep or a slow rotation. No frozen frame longer than a second.
Marks arrive by being made: a line grows, an outline prints behind the scan, a counter rolls and lands with a small pop, a reticle snaps with overshoot.
Time changes are scans, never dissolves; their spacing tells the speed, and the camera moves with them (accelerating as the steps shorten, braking on the last).
Never moves: the ground under its annotations, the instrument positions.

native_moves.name: The map against the photograph
native_moves.does: The camera falls into the printed map of the claim; a scanner bar tears it away and the ground is underneath; the name outlives the page.
native_moves.fits: a lake still on maps but gone; a cleared concession forest; a planned city never built.

native_moves.name: Time rings in a locked frame
native_moves.does: Dated plates scan in one by one; each leaves its outline, the band lost between two rings flashes.
native_moves.fits: a glacier's retreat; a city's sprawl; a fire scar season after season.

native_moves.name: The range line
native_moves.does: Mark the destination, grow a ticked line from A to B, chase the tip while the reading counts up, land on the number, pull back to show the whole distance.
native_moves.fits: how far a shore moved; a village to its well; a camp to the border.

native_moves.name: The dive and the climb
native_moves.does: One zoom from orbit to the ground, or back.
native_moves.fits: locating anything; a scale reveal; an ending that returns one place to the planet.

native_moves.name: Colour returns where the story turns
native_moves.does: Only the subject regains true colour inside the grey.
native_moves.fits: an irrigated field; a refilled reservoir; a regrown forest.

native_moves.name: The reticle becomes the frame
native_moves.does: the lock-on brackets open out to frame a title card or the last reading.

score.note: telemetry pings, detuned-saw pads, timpani and gran cassa for weight
